benchmarks.task: walking route between two markers on a map image, as a JSON polyline
benchmarks.dataset: De Pijp (Amsterdam) held-out validation routes, 500 routes, 512 px map renders
benchmarks.metric: solved (polyline rule: endpoints within 6 m, no building crossed, ≤ 1.10 × walking length)

sources.title: graahand/qwen-vl-2b-lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: LoRA adapter fine-tuned for OCR-style key-value extraction from document images. Use this adapter with the base model for document OCR and key-value extraction. May hallucinate values not present in the image. Performance depends on image quality and layout similarity to training data.

sources.title: TIGER-Lab/VLM2Vec-Qwen2VL-2B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: In this paper, we focus on building a unified multimodal embedding model suitable for a wide range of tasks. Our approach is based on transforming an existing, well-trained Vision-Language Model (VLM) into an embedding model.

sources.title: LoRA Fine-tuning | QwenLM/Qwen-VL | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: LoRA is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique that significantly reduces memory requirements while maintaining model performance. This page covers the technical implementation, configuration options, and best practices for LoRA fine-tuning in the Qwen-VL repository.
